title: Lawful Obstruction Is Given Right Through the Guaranteed Freedoms of Magna Carta Article 61
summary: Press release from an author promoting Magna Carta Article 61 as the only true law and a right to refuse invalid legislation.

assertions.quote: clearly describes the aspects of The Magna Carta Article 61 as the only true law
The Right to refuse to abide by any Law, Legislation, or other Statutory instrument which has been put in place invalidly

verdicts.note: Clause 61 was annulled within months in 1215 and never reissued; UK courts reject 'lawful rebellion' defences.
